subject: a tall broad-shouldered Scottish-born man with thick wavy hair, a high forehead, a full beard and deep-set thoughtful eyes, wearing a dark Victorian frock coat, waistcoat and white shirt

panels.01-speakinghead: two Scottish teenage brothers in 1860s waistcoats and rolled shirtsleeves building a mechanical speaking head on a workbench in an Edinburgh study, a carved model head with a soft rubber mouth and bellows beneath it, tools and wood shavings, gas lamp light, curious and determined
panels.02-boston: {S} aged about 24 with a dark beard standing beside a large chart of curved phonetic symbols in a plain Boston schoolroom in 1871, pointing to a symbol while a small group of attentive children in 1870s clothes watch his lips closely, window light, warm and patient
panels.03-dreaming: {S} aged about 27 with a dark beard sitting alone on a grassy bank under tall elm trees above a wide winding river in the Ontario countryside in summer 1874, a notebook open on his knee and a pencil in hand, sketching coils and a membrane, deep in thought, golden afternoon light
panels.04-reed: {S} aged about 28 with a dark beard bending close to a row of electromagnets with thin steel reeds on a cluttered workbench in a Boston attic workshop in 1875, ear held close, a younger assistant with a moustache visible through a doorway plucking a reed, wires strung between rooms, intense listening
panels.05-watson: {S} aged about 29 with a dark beard leaning toward a small brass and wood liquid transmitter on a table in a gaslit Boston room on 10 March 1876, speaking into its mouthpiece, wires running through the doorway to the next room, an open laboratory notebook beside him, a historic moment of invention
panels.06-paris: {S} aged about 29 with a dark beard seated in a small rural Ontario telegraph office in August 1876, holding a round iron-box telephone receiver to his ear with eyes closed, listening in wonder, telegraph keys and paper tape on the counter, a telegraph operator watching, late afternoon sun through the window
panels.07-photophone: {S} aged about 33 with a dark beard at an open upper window of a Washington laboratory in 1880, holding a listening tube connected to a curved reflector catching a beam of sunlight, across the street a man on a brick school roof speaking into a mirrored transmitter, rays of sunlight drawn between them
panels.08-hd4: an older {S} with a full white beard and a tweed cape standing on a wooden dock on a wide blue lake in Nova Scotia in 1919, watching a long grey cigar-shaped hydrofoil boat race past high above the water on underwater wings, spray behind it, green hills, a young engineer beside him
